## Problem

Describe the problem (concisely).

## Steps to reproduce
With asan build:
```lua
vim.o.swapfile = false
vim.o.shadafile = "NONE"
local api = vim.api

vim.cmd("tabnew")
vim.cmd("vsplit")
api.nvim_create_autocmd("WinLeave", {
	callback = function()
		local bs = api.nvim_list_bufs()
		pcall(api.nvim_buf_delete, bs[#bs], { force = true })
	end,
})
vim.cmd("wincmd x")
api.nvim_buf_delete(2, { force = true })
```
